verdict.rationale: The CLI documents `lms load --gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0`, and LM Studio runs on llama.cpp. A fractional GPU ratio implies splitting a model between GPU and CPU, which is the core mechanism this story needs. The evidence is a single flag line, though, and never says this lets models exceed available VRAM. One community report says the UI gave no way to set CUDA acceleration before loading a model, a UX caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that partial offload runs models larger than VRAM, a GUI offload control, guidance on performance trade-offs, and hands-on corroboration of CPU+GPU split runs.
